title: Bar Salts Pink Lemonade Flavour Concentrate 30ml By Vampire Vape
description: Experience the vibrant and refreshing summer flavours of Pink Lemonade with this flavour concentrate from Vampire Vape's Bar Salts collection. This 30ml bottle captures the essence of a sweet and tangy pink lemonade, blending a slight citrus bite with a hint of red fruit for a perfectly balanced vape experience. Ideal for DIY vapers looking to mix their own e-liquids, this concentrate provides a strong base flavour that can be diluted to suit your taste preferences. Simply add nicotine shots and a VG/PG base to craft an e-liquid that's exactly right for your vaping style. Please Note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes.
